title: Persona 5 Royal
provenance: Reported by ry-diffusion (highball-db#22, 2026-09-12): M5, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.7, engine x64-crossover26.3-r7, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes of play on medium graphics. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: DirectX 11. Reported playing on D3DMetal with the CrossOver-tree engine (x64-crossover26.3-r7); the reporter says it does not work on the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines. Medium graphics on an M5 in a hot room, so the reporter's Mac was throttling. Do not use DXMT for this game for now: it needs DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 to show a window, and with that set the reporter's Mac kernel-panicked (a watchdog panic, macOS's GPU driver going down, not a game crash). Not reproduced here.

knownIssues.symptom: On DXMT with DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 the whole Mac kernel-panics (reported on an M5, macOS 27.0, engine r7)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; the panic log names the watchdog timer, which is what fires when the GPU driver stops responding
knownIssues.fix: use D3DMetal, which the recipe sets

knownIssues.symptom: Does not run on the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines
knownIssues.fix: the recipe asks for engine x64-crossover26.3-r7
